description: Source code for the ApiStreamingRootResource class, which provides REST API endpoints for streaming statistics, receivers, batches, and operations in Apache Spark's streaming module.

classes.name: ApiStreamingRootResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for streaming statistics and batch data in Spark Streaming.

methods.name: receiversList
methods.description: Returns a list of receiver information.

methods.name: oneReceiver
methods.description: Returns information for a specific receiver by streamId.

methods.name: batchesList
methods.description: Returns a list of batch information filtered by status.

methods.name: oneBatch
methods.description: Returns details of a specific batch by batchId.

methods.name: operationsList
methods.description: Returns list of output operations for a batch.

methods.name: oneOperation
methods.description: Returns details of a specific output operation.

methods.name: avgRate
methods.description: Calculates average rate from a sequence of doubles.

methods.name: avgTime
methods.description: Calculates average time from a sequence of longs.
